app.name: ReceiptLens
app.description: Scan receipts, automatically extract expense information, and organize spending in one simple app.
app.target_audience: Consumers and small business users who want to organize expenses from receipts.
app.problem_solved: Manually entering receipt information is slow and error-prone. ReceiptLens automates receipt capture, text recognition, expense extraction, and local organization.

product_strategy.market_opportunity: Receipt and expense management is a proven mobile utility category with recurring demand from consumers and small businesses.
product_strategy.competitive_advantage: Fast receipt capture, on-device processing, simple expense organization, multilingual support, privacy-first design, and Huawei ecosystem compatibility.
product_strategy.monetization_strategy: Free application supported by Huawei Petal Ads. Ads must not interfere with the primary receipt scanning workflow.

features.name: Receipt camera scanning
features.description: Capture a receipt using the device camera.

features.name: Receipt image import
features.description: Import an existing receipt image from the device gallery.

features.name: Document detection
features.description: Detect the receipt/document boundaries and correct perspective when possible.

features.name: OCR
features.description: Recognize text from receipt images using Huawei ML Kit capabilities where supported.

features.name: Receipt information extraction
features.description: Extract merchant name, transaction date, total amount, tax amount, currency, and probable expense category from recognized receipt text.

features.name: Receipt review
features.description: Allow the user to review and correct extracted information before saving.

features.name: Local receipt storage
features.description: Store receipt records and associated images locally on the device.

features.name: Expense dashboard
features.description: Display spending totals and basic expense statistics.

features.name: Receipt history
features.description: Display previously saved receipts in chronological order.

features.name: Search and filters
features.description: Search receipts and filter them by date, category, merchant, and amount.

features.name: Receipt detail
features.description: View the complete stored receipt including image and extracted information.

features.name: Receipt editing
features.description: Edit merchant, date, amount, tax, currency, category, and notes.

features.name: Receipt deletion
features.description: Delete individual receipts and their locally stored images.

features.name: Export
features.description: Export selected expense information in a useful user-readable format.

features.name: Petal Ads
features.description: Display Huawei Petal Ads according to the monetization configuration and frequency rules.

features.name: Dark mode
features.description: Support light, dark, and system theme modes.

features.name: Localization
features.description: Support all configured application languages and automatically select the device language.

features.name: Accessibility
features.description: Provide accessible labels, adequate touch targets, readable typography, semantic UI elements, and screen-reader compatibility.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Provide a quick overview of expenses and primary scanning actions.

screens.name: Receipt Import
screens.purpose: Select a receipt image from the device.

screens.name: Review Receipt
screens.purpose: Show OCR results and allow the user to correct extracted information.

screens.name: Receipt Detail
screens.purpose: Display a saved receipt and its complete information.

requirements: Database operations must be performed off the main thread.
Use Room migrations for schema changes.
Receipt deletion must also remove its associated local image.
No receipt data may be uploaded to a remote server in V1.

permissions.purpose: Import receipt images when required by the Android version and selected image-picker implementation.

monetization.ad_frequency_rules: Ads must never interrupt camera capture, OCR processing, receipt review, or data entry. Banner ads may appear in appropriate non-critical screens. Interstitial ads must have conservative frequency limits and must never appear immediately after every scan. Rewarded ads may optionally unlock an export-related convenience feature. Ad configuration must be isolated so monetization can be changed without modifying core receipt-processing logic.

requirements: All visible application strings must use Android string resources.
No hard-coded user-visible text.
Pluralization must use Android plural resources where applicable.
Date and number formatting must respect locale.
Currency formatting must respect the selected currency and locale.
Arabic layouts must support right-to-left presentation.
Material 3
Clear visual hierarchy
Large primary scan action
Responsive layouts
No unnecessary animations
Accessible contrast
Minimum comfortable touch target sizes
Support system font scaling
Receipt images must remain on-device in V1.
OCR processing must occur locally whenever supported.
No receipt image or OCR content may be sent to a cloud AI service.
No user account is required.
No backend is required.
No financial information may be transmitted by the application.
The privacy policy must clearly explain that receipt images and expense information may contain personal or financial information and are processed/stored locally.
Advertising SDK data handling must be documented separately according to the applicable Petal Ads requirements.
Deleting a receipt must delete its associated local image and database record.
privacy._collects_personal_data_note: Set to true on 2026-09-07: the Huawei Petal Ads SDK collects OAID, IP, device and app information, so AppGallery's privacy tags must say Yes. The app's own data stays on the device.

requirements: V1 must not depend on a cloud LLM.
OCR must work offline where supported by the selected Huawei ML Kit capabilities.
Receipt extraction should combine OCR results with deterministic parsing rules.
The application must never claim AI accuracy that cannot be verified.
If a field cannot be confidently extracted, the field must remain editable and the uncertainty must be visible to the user.
Total amount must be distinguished from subtotals whenever possible.
Tax must never be assumed when it cannot be detected.
Currency should be inferred from the receipt when possible and otherwise use the user's configured default.
Category inference must be treated as a suggestion and must remain editable.
The user must always be able to correct extracted values.
Scanning must not require an internet connection.
OCR must operate offline where supported.
Receipt storage must work offline.
Dashboard and history must work offline.
Search and filtering must work offline.
Statistics must work offline.
Export must work offline.
Only advertising and any future explicitly documented online functionality may require network access.
Loss of network connectivity must not cause loss of receipt data.

additional_tests: Test invalid and incomplete OCR results.
Test manual correction of extracted values.
Test process recreation and state restoration.
Test application behavior after device rotation/configuration change where applicable.
Test application startup without network connectivity.
Test application behavior when camera permission is denied.
Test application behavior when image access is denied.
Test corrupted or unsupported image input.
Test release build with minification enabled.
Test Petal Ads failure without breaking core application functionality.

requirements: Release builds must use a production signing key.
Signing credentials must never be committed to Git.
Signing credentials must never be included in source code.
Debug builds must never be submitted to AppGallery.
APK and AAB artifacts must be generated separately.
Version code must increase for every release.
Version name must follow semantic versioning conventions where practical.
Use real application screenshots generated from the tested build.
Do not use fake UI screenshots.
Generate store metadata separately for each supported language.
Verify package name availability before final release.
Verify application signing configuration before upload.
Complete Huawei developer/account requirements before automated submission.
Complete required content rating and privacy declarations.
Store AppGallery identifiers and credentials outside source code.

icon.description: Professional ReceiptLens application icon suitable for AppGallery and Android launcher requirements.

screenshots.source: Real screenshots from the tested application build

marketing_assets.description: Optional AppGallery promotional assets generated separately from functional application screenshots.

requirements: Never hard-code API keys, advertising identifiers, signing passwords, or service credentials.
Do not commit keystores to the repository.
Do not commit local.properties or environment-specific secrets.
Use build-time configuration for secrets.
Validate imported images before processing.
Avoid unnecessary external storage access.
Use application-private storage for receipt images whenever possible.
Do not expose receipt image paths through publicly accessible storage.
Camera preview must remain responsive.
OCR processing must not block the main UI thread.
Large receipt images should be resized/compressed appropriately before OCR when this does not materially reduce recognition quality.
Database operations must not run on the main thread.
Lazy lists must be used for potentially large receipt histories.
The application must avoid unnecessary memory retention of full-resolution receipt images.
All camera failures must show a user-readable error.
OCR failures must allow manual receipt entry.
Unsupported image formats must be handled gracefully.
Database failures must not silently delete data.
Ad loading failures must not block the application.
Network failures must not break offline features.
Unexpected errors must show a recoverable state instead of a blank screen.

acceptance_criteria: Application launches successfully on a supported Android device.
Camera permission is requested only when required.
OCR works using the configured Huawei ML Kit capabilities.
Extracted receipt fields are presented for user review.
Users can manually correct extracted information.
Receipts remain available without internet connectivity.
Receipt deletion removes both database data and the associated local image.
Petal Ads integration does not break core functionality.
No receipt image or OCR content is uploaded to a cloud AI service.
No backend is required for V1.
No Google Play Services dependency is introduced.
No placeholder screens remain in the release build.
No secrets are committed to the repository.
AppGallery metadata and required assets are prepared.
Real screenshots from the tested application are prepared for AppGallery submission.
Application complies with applicable Huawei AppGallery requirements.
